ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, and attacks hit <@ba.vup>5</> times for <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK per hit; if Delivery Coordinates are on the field, deals a single instance of Physical splash damage equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@cannon_atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK at its location and deploys the ground Operator with the longest Redeployment Time there, granting that Operator <@ba.vup>{attack@sp}</> SP
<@ba.rem>Gains Delivery Coordinates after deployment; skill activation grants {attack@trigger_time} ammo, each attack consumes 5 ammo, and the skill ends when all ammo is used (Can manually deactivate skill)</>
